//: Copy to a project root as `.nvim-tools.json` (or run :ProjectToolsInit).
//runner: local | docker | compose | sail | custom — where every tool runs
//container: runner=docker: the `docker exec` target, e.g. myapp-php-1
//user: optional: run as this user inside the container, e.g. www-data
//prefix: runner=custom: argv placed in front of every command
//sail: runner=sail: path to the sail binary (default vendor/bin/sail)
//tools: per-tool overrides; any of the keys above plus cmd/args/enabled (phpstan: memory_limit defaults to 1G)
